DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見つからないのですね。最後に見た場所から順に伺ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find your bicycle, I understand. May I ask about things in order, starting with where you last saw it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼の一時ごろ、店の東側に停めました。三時に戻ると、その場所にありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一時に停め三時に戻った時なくなっていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I parked it on the east side of the shop at about one this afternoon. When I returned at three, it was no longer there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you parked at one and found it gone when you returned at three. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 東側には駐輪場所が二か所あります。入口に近い方か、奥の方か覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are two bicycle parking areas on the east side. Do you remember whether it was the one near the entrance or farther back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の屋根がある方です。隣に赤い自転車があったのは覚えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 奥の屋根付き駐輪場所と隣の赤い車体を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The covered one farther back. I remember a red bicycle next to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the covered parking area at the back and the red bicycle beside yours. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車体の色や、防犯登録の情報が分かるものを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the bicycle's color and about anything that would give us its crime-prevention registration information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、前のかごの右側がへこんでいます。登録番号は家の控えを見ないと分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀色とへこんだかごを示し登録番号は自宅で調べると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is silver, and the right side of its front basket is dented. I will need to check the copy at home for the registration number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the silver color and dented basket, and say you will check the registration number at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴を記録します。鍵はかけていましたか。鍵そのものは今ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record those features. Did you lock it? Do you have the key itself with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後輪の鍵をかけて、鍵はここにあります。盗まれたのか、移動されたのか判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施錠と鍵の所持を説明し移動の可能性もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I locked the rear wheel, and I have the key here. I cannot tell whether it was stolen or moved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it was locked and you have the key, and mention that it may have been moved. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現時点では決めつけず確認しましょう。登録番号の控えが見つかったら、追加でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check without jumping to conclusions at this stage. If you find the copy of the registration number, please let us know as additional information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 帰宅して控えを探します。後で連絡するときに、今日の相談をどう説明すればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅で控えを探した後の相談の引継ぎ方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look for the copy when I get home. When I contact you later, how should I explain today's consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask how to have today's consultation followed up after you look for the copy at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談した日時とお名前を伝えてください。こちらの連絡先もお渡しします。道中お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give the date and time of your consultation and your name. I will also give you our contact details. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の発送ですね。送り方について、ご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are mailing an envelope, I see. Do you have any preferences about how to send it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先から、届いたか確認できる方法で送ってほしいと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出先が到着確認可能な発送方法を求めていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient asked me to send it by a method that lets them check whether it has arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient requires a shipping method that allows arrival to be checked. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達状況を調べたいのか、受け取った記録も必要なのかで、選び方が変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The choice depends on whether you want to check delivery progress or also need a record of receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまで聞いていませんでした。追跡できるだけで、相手が受け取った証明にもなるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追跡だけで受取証明になるのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not ask that much. Does tracking alone also serve as proof that the other party received it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether tracking alone counts as proof of receipt. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ意味とは限りません。提出先が求める記録に合うサービスを確認して選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: They do not necessarily mean the same thing. Let us check and choose a service matching the record the recipient requires.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 担当者に電話してみます。封筒はまだ閉じずに、ここで内容を確かめてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先に電話し未封緘の内容を確かめる場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call the person in charge. May I keep the envelope unsealed and check its contents here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will call the recipient and ask where you can check the contents before sealing the envelope. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 脇の記入台をご利用ください。宛先と必要な記録が確認できたら、窓口へ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use the writing counter to the side. Return to the service counter once you have confirmed the address and the required record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認できました。受取の記録も残る方法が必要だそうです。対応する送り方と料金を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取記録が必要と分かり対応サービスと料金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked. They say a method that also leaves a record of receipt is required. Please tell me the available methods and their prices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that a record of receipt is required, and ask about suitable services and prices. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒の大きさと重さを測って、条件に合う候補をご案内します。差出控えも保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will measure and weigh the envelope and explain options that meet the requirements. Please keep the mailing receipt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 候補の中から選んで送ります。控えは書類のコピーと一緒に保管して、問い合わせに使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 方法を選び差出控えをコピーと保管して問い合わせに使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose one of those options and send it. I will keep the receipt with a copy of the documents and use it for inquiries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will choose a method and keep the mailing receipt with the copy for inquiries. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは計測して受付を進めます。控えのお渡しまで少々お待ちください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will measure it and proceed with acceptance. Please wait a moment until we give you the receipt. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座についてのご相談ですね。どのような用途でお使いになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a new account. What do you plan to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 就職先から給与の振込口座を用意するよう言われました。こちらで申し込めるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新しい勤務先の給与受取用口座を申し込みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My new employer told me to prepare an account for salary payments. I would like to discuss whether I can apply here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you would like to apply for an account to receive your new employer's salary payments. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本人確認の書類を確認します。現在の住所が記載されたものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your identification documents. Do you have anything showing your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードはありますが、引越したばかりで住所の更新がまだです。古い住所のままです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引越し後で在留カードに旧住所が残っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my residence card, but I have just moved and have not updated the address yet. It still has my old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your residence card still shows your old address after moving. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず必要書類と住所の確認方法をご案内します。この状態ですぐ受付できるとは、まだお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, we will explain the required documents and how to verify your address. We cannot yet promise to accept an application immediately in this situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。勤務先の証明も必要なら、何を会社に頼めばよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先証明が必要な場合に頼む資料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. If proof of employment is needed too, please tell me what I should ask the company for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check what documents to request if proof of employment is needed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 口座の用途やご状況を確認して、必要な資料を一覧にします。いつまでに会社へ口座情報を出しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the account's purpose and your circumstances and make a list of required documents. By when must you give your account information to the company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社からは今月末までと言われています。手続きに時間がかかる場合は、早めに会社へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 月末の期限を示し時間がかかれば会社に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The company told me by the end of this month. If the procedure takes time, I will speak to them early.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the month-end deadline and say you will consult the company if it takes time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その期限も担当者に伝えましょう。書類が揃ってからの手順と、来店予約の要否も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us tell the person in charge about that deadline too. We will also check the steps after the documents are ready and whether a branch appointment is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は必要書類の一覧を受け取り、住所を更新した後の申し込み方法まで確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要書類一覧と住所更新後の申込方法を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I would like to receive the list of documents and also confirm how to apply after updating my address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to confirm the document list and how to apply after updating your address. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、担当の窓口へおつなぎします。確認した内容を持ち帰れるようにしますので、よろしくお願いいたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will refer you to the relevant counter. We will make sure you can take the confirmed information home. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 玉ねぎの棚をご覧になっていましたね。表示について気になる点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were looking at the onion shelf. Is there something about the signs you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二百九十八円という札は、一袋の値段ですか。下に小さい文字があって読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二百九十八円が一袋の値段か小字を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Does this sign saying 298 yen mean the price for one bag? There is small print underneath that I cannot read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether 298 yen is for one bag and ask about the small print. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さな文字は「二袋で」です。対象になる袋を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The small print says “for two bags.” Let us check which bags are included together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうだったんですね。こちらの大きい袋も、二袋の組み合わせに入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大袋も二袋セットの対象になるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oh, I see. Can this large bag also be included in the two-bag offer?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the large bag is also eligible for the two-bag deal. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きい袋は別の商品です。この表示の対象は、横に並んだ小袋だけになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The large bag is a different product. This sign applies only to the small bags lined up beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人暮らしなので小袋を一つにします。一袋だけだと、いくらになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人暮らしのため小袋一つの価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I live alone, so I will take just one small bag. How much is one bag on its own?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you live alone and ask the price of one small bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一袋の価格はこちらの表示です。まとめ買いの額と取り違えないよう、札を指してご説明しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The price for one bag is shown here. I will point to the sign as I explain so it is not confused with the multibuy price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。この小袋には三個入っていますが、隣の四個入りとは価格が同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三個入りと四個入りの値段が同じか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. This small bag has three onions. Is its price the same as the bag of four beside it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check whether the three-onion and four-onion bags cost the same. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の商品番号なので、それぞれの表示を確認します。三個入りを選ぶなら、この札が対応しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: They have different product numbers, so we will check each sign. If you choose the bag of three, this is its sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 必要なのは三個なので、こちらだけ買います。レジでも一袋の価格で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三個入り一袋を選びレジで単価確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I only need three, so I will buy this one. Please also check the single-bag price at the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one bag of three and ask for the unit price to be checked at the register. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。対象の袋をお持ちいただければ、レジで価格を確認します。どうぞお買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Bring the relevant bag and we will check its price at the register. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の案内図はこちらです。お連れの方がベンチに座っていらっしゃいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the park map. The person with you is sitting on the bench, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一緒に来た母が疲れたので、長い散歩はやめて、入口に近いところだけ歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母の疲れを理由に入口付近の短い散歩へ変更すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother, who came with me, is tired, so we will give up a long walk and only walk near the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are changing to a short walk near the entrance because your mother is tired. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの入口から入られましたか。帰りに使う入口を基準に考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which entrance did you come in through? Let us plan around the entrance you will use to leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: バス停に近い入口から入りました。帰りもそこへ戻らないと、道が分からなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: バス停側から入り同じ入口へ戻りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We came through the entrance near the bus stop. I think I will lose my way unless we go back there when we leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered by the bus stop and want to return to the same entrance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の印を見て、その入口を確かめましょう。休憩を挟んで戻る道を選びますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us identify that entrance using the marks on the map. Would you like a route that brings you back with a rest along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。木陰で休める場所が途中にあれば、そこまで行って引き返したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 木陰の休憩場所まで歩いて戻る案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If there is somewhere in the shade to rest on the way, I would like to walk that far and then turn back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Propose walking to a shaded resting place and returning. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図にはこのあたりに休憩場所の印があります。ただ、今座れるかどうかは行ってみないと分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The map has a resting-place mark around here. However, we cannot know whether seats are available now until you go there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 空いていなければ、今のベンチに戻ります。その休憩場所までは階段を使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 満席なら元のベンチへ戻り階段の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it is full, we will return to the bench we are using now. Are there stairs on the way to that resting place?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return to the original bench if it is full, and ask whether there are stairs. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 階段の記号がある道は避けましょう。現地の案内も見て、通れない場合は無理に進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us avoid paths marked with a stairs symbol. Check the signs there too, and do not force your way onward if a path cannot be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口と今のベンチを地図の写真で覚えておきます。母の様子を見て、難しければそのまま帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図を撮り母の様子次第で散歩せず帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take a photo of the map to remember the entrance and our current bench. I will watch how my mother is doing, and we will go straight home if it seems difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph the map and go home without walking if your mother's condition calls for it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その予定なら、急いで遠くへ行く必要はありませんね。お母さまとゆっくりお過ごしください。では、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: With that plan, there is no need to hurry far away. Take your time with your mother. Take care, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検索した経路について、お確かめになりたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something about the route you searched for that you would like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から駅名が届きましたが、似た名前が二つ出てきます。どちらを選ぶか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の駅名を検索すると似た名前が二つ出て選べず困っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend sent me a station name, but two similar names appear in the search. I cannot decide which one to choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that searching for your friend's station gives two similar names and you are unsure which to select. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 駅名だけでなく、路線や地域がわかる記載はありますか。別の駅を選ぶと、経路も変わってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there anything identifying the line or area, as well as the station name? Choosing a different station would change the route too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 路線名は書いてありません。友人に最寄り駅の正式な名前を聞き直しますので、少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 路線名がなく最寄り駅の正式名称を友人に聞き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is no line name. I will ask my friend for the nearest station's official name again, so please wait a moment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that no line is given and you will ask your friend again for the nearest station's official name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。出発を急ぐより、先に目的地を確かめましょう。お返事は届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. Let us establish your destination before rushing to leave. Has the reply arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 届きました。こちらの駅だそうです。乗り換えが五分と表示されていますが、初めてなので心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返信の駅を示し初めての五分の乗り換えが心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has. They say it is this station. The transfer is shown as five minutes, but it is my first time and I am worried.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the station in the reply and express concern about a first-time five-minute transfer. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 初めての駅ではホームの移動に時間がかかることもあります。一本後の接続も比べてみましょう。到着が遅くなっても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Moving between platforms can take time at an unfamiliar station. Let us also compare a connection one train later. Would arriving later be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人には少し遅れてもよいと言われました。急がず乗り換えられるほうを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人に多少遅れてよいと言われ急がず乗り換える経路を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend said a little later is fine. I would like to choose the option that lets me transfer without rushing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your friend allows a slight delay and request a route with an unhurried transfer. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、乗り換え駅で待ち時間が長いほうの経路を確認します。案内には行き先と乗る列車の時刻を分けて書きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let us check the route with the longer wait at the transfer station. I will write the destination and the time of your train separately in the directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その案内をお願いします。同じホームでも違う行き先があるか、乗る前に表示を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を書いてもらい同じホームでも乗る前に行き先表示を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Before boarding, I will check the signs to see whether trains to different destinations use the same platform too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for written directions and say you will check the destination display before boarding, even on the same platform. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示と放送に変更があれば、そちらもご確認ください。それでは、友人とのお出かけをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: If there are changes on the signs or in announcements, please check those too. Enjoy your outing with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請用紙をお取りになる前に、ご用途を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you take a certificate application form, may I ask what you need it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 資格講習を申し込むためです。住所を確認できる書類が必要とありますが、証明書の名前が書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 資格講習で住所確認書類が必要だが証明書名の指定がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: To apply for a qualification course. It says I need a document confirming my address, but it does not name the certificate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a qualification course requires address verification but does not specify a certificate name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その案内だけでは、必要な書類をこちらで決められません。提出先の問い合わせ先は載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot decide which document you need from those instructions alone. Is a contact for the recipient listed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールアドレスが載っています。住民票が必要なのか、ほかの書類でよいのか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メールで住民票が必要か別書類でもよいか提出先に聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is an email address. I will ask whether a residence record is required or another document is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will email the recipient to ask whether a residence record or another document is acceptable. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: あわせて、本人だけのものか世帯全員のものか、記載事項の指定があるかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check whether it must cover only you or the whole household, and whether specific entries are required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族の情報は講習には関係ないので、不要なら入れたくありません。発行日についても条件を聞いたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不要な家族情報は載せたくなく発行日の条件も聞くべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family's information is unrelated to the course, so I would rather not include it if unnecessary. Should I ask about conditions on the issue date too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not want unnecessary family information included and check whether to ask about the issue date. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。発行から何か月以内などの条件がある場合があります。返事が来るまで申請を待つこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. There may be conditions such as issue within a certain number of months. You can also wait to apply until a reply arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は急いで発行せずに待ちます。返事を持ってもう一度来るとき、本人確認の持ち物も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の発行は待ち再来庁時の本人確認書類を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait rather than rush to have it issued today. I also want to check what identification to bring when I come back with the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait today and want to check identification documents for your return visit. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの申請案内で、本人確認書類と手数料をご覧ください。ご自身が申請する場合と代理の方では、必要なものが異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please see the identification documents and fees in this application guide. Requirements differ for applying yourself and through a representative.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次も自分で来ます。提出先の返事と申請案内を照らし合わせてから、必要なものだけ申請します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次回も自分で来て提出先の返事と申請案内を照合し必要なものを申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will come myself next time too. I will compare the recipient's reply with the application guide and apply only for what is necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return yourself, compare the recipient's reply with the guide, and apply for the necessary items. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 条件がわかりましたら、その案内を窓口でお見せください。お手数ですが、またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you know the conditions, please show those instructions at the counter. Sorry for the extra trip; we will welcome you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の空いている欄について、説明が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like an explanation of the blank fields on the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「既往歴」と書いてあるところが読めません。今の腹痛をここに書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 既往歴の意味と現在の腹痛をそこに書くべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot read the part marked “medical history.” Should I write my current stomach pain here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what medical history means and whether your current stomach pain belongs there. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そこは、これまでにかかった病気や受けた手術を書く欄です。今回の腹痛は、今の症状の欄に書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That field is for illnesses you have had and operations you have undergone. Please write this stomach pain in the current symptoms field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、五年前に手術を受けたことはこちらですね。病名の日本語がわからないので、母国の書類を持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五年前の手術を記入することを確認し病名の日本語が不明で母国の資料を持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then this is where I write that I had surgery five years ago. I do not know the illness's Japanese name, so I brought documents from my home country.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the surgery five years ago goes here, and say you brought home-country documents because you do not know the illness's Japanese name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類があることを医師に伝えましょう。わからない病名を推測して書く必要はありません。今回の痛みはいつ始まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us tell the doctor you have documents. You do not need to guess an unfamiliar illness name. When did the current pain start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜からです。痛む場所をうまく言えないので、この体の図を指して説明してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨夜から痛み体の図を指して場所を説明してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Last night. I cannot describe the painful spot well; may I point to this body diagram to explain?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the pain started last night and ask to explain its location using the body diagram. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。場所を指しながら、痛みが続いているか、強くなったり弱くなったりするかもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. As you point, also say whether the pain is continuous or becomes stronger and weaker.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ずっと同じではなく、時々強くなります。食事との関係はわからないので、わからないと答えてよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時々強くなる痛みで食事との関係は不明と答えてよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is not always the same; it sometimes gets stronger. I do not know its relation to meals, so it is okay to say I do not know, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you may report pain that sometimes worsens and an unknown relation to meals. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。わかることと、まだわからないことを分けてお伝えください。待っている間に強く痛む場合は、職員に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Exactly. Please distinguish what you know from what you do not yet know. If you have strong pain while waiting, tell a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 以前の手術の書類と、この問診票を診察で出します。痛みが変わったら、待っている間でも知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手術資料と問診票を診察で出し待機中でも痛みの変化を知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will present the old surgery documents and this questionnaire at the consultation. I will tell someone if the pain changes, even while waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will present the surgery documents and questionnaire and report pain changes even while waiting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 医師へお話を引き継ぎます。書類をなくさないようお手元に置いてください。それでは、お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your information to the doctor. Keep the documents with you so they do not get lost. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 電話で不審な支払いを求められたとのことですね。今も相手と通話は続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were asked for a suspicious payment over the phone, I understand. Are you still on the call with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう切りました。携帯会社の担当だと言われ、今日中に電子マネーを買って番号を教えるよう求められました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯会社を名乗り今日中に電子マネー購入と番号通知を求めた通話を切ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have hung up. They claimed to work for my mobile provider and asked me to buy electronic money today and tell them the number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you ended a call from someone claiming to be your mobile provider and demanding electronic money and its number today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入したり、番号を伝えたりしましたか。相手の言った電話番号へ、折り返しはされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you buy it or give them a number? Have you called back the telephone number they gave you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。ただ、相手が私の名前を知っていたので、本当の請求かもしれないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入も折り返しもせず相手が名前を知り本当の請求かと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have done neither. But they knew my name, so I thought it might be a genuine bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you neither bought anything nor called back, but thought the demand might be genuine because they knew your name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名前を知っていることだけでは、正規の請求と判断できません。契約先に確認する場合は、相手の示した連絡先ではなく、ご自身で公式の窓口を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Knowing your name alone does not establish a genuine bill. To check with your provider, find its official contact yourself rather than using the one the caller supplied.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求書に載っている連絡先から確認します。通話は録音していませんが、今から覚えている内容を書いても役に立ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 請求書の連絡先で確認し録音がないため記憶を今から書いて役立つか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use the contact on my bill to check. I did not record the call; would writing down what I remember now still help?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check via the bill's contact and ask whether writing from memory helps without a recording. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。着信時刻、表示された番号、言われた内容を分けて書いてください。覚えていないところは、そのまま不明としてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Write the call time, displayed number, and what they said separately. Mark anything you do not remember as unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号と時刻は履歴に残っています。「今日中」という言葉と電子マネーの要求だけは、はっきり覚えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号と時刻は履歴にあり今日中と電子マネーの要求は確実に覚えていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number and time remain in my call history. I clearly remember only the words “today” and the demand for electronic money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the number and time are in your history, and you clearly remember “today” and the electronic money demand. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録を拝見します。もう一度かかってきても、会話を続けたり指示に従ったりする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me look at that record. If they call again, you do not need to continue talking or obey their instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 履歴を消さずに残します。家族にも、私の名前を知っていてもすぐ支払わないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 履歴を保存し名前を知る相手でもすぐ支払わないよう家族へ伝えると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the history without deleting it. I will tell my family not to pay immediately, even if the person knows my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to keep the history and tell your family not to pay immediately even when the caller knows your name. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録の整理をこちらでお手伝いします。ほかにも不審な連絡があれば、またご相談ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will help organize the records here. Please consult us again if you receive any other suspicious contact. Take care, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 国内宛てのお荷物ですね。送り状の宛先を一緒に確認いたしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: A domestic parcel, I see. Let us check the address on the shipping label together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に衣類と本を送ります。引っ越したばかりなので、送ってもらった住所を写しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族に衣類と本を送り引っ越し後に送られた住所を写したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending clothes and books to my family. They have just moved, so I copied the address they sent me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are sending clothes and books to your family and copied the address sent after their move. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 集合住宅のお名前はありますが、部屋番号の欄が空いています。部屋番号はおわかりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The apartment building's name is present, but the room number is blank. Do you know the room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 忘れてしまいました。前の住所の番号と混ざりそうなので、今ここで家族に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所の番号と混同しそうなので家族に今確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I forgot it. I may mix it up with the old address's number, so I will check with my family right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will check with your family now because you might confuse it with the old room number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先を確かめてから受付しましょう。その間に大きさと重さを測ります。配送方法にご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us confirm the address before accepting it. Meanwhile, we will measure its size and weight. Do you have a preferred delivery method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 追跡できる方法が希望です。もし家族が留守だったら、玄関前に置かれるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡可能な方法を希望し家族不在時は玄関前に置くのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like a trackable method. If my family is out, would it be left outside the front door?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a trackable method and ask whether it would be left at the door if your family is away. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受け取り方はサービスや設定によって異なります。選べる送り方を確認して、対面での受け取りを希望することも含めてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Receipt methods vary by service and settings. We will check the available shipping methods and explain them, including your preference for in-person receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信が来ました。三〇二号室でした。番号を直したら、料金を聞いてから送り方を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三〇二号室と判明し訂正後に料金を聞いて送り方を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: A reply came. It is room 302. Once I correct the number, I will ask about the cost before choosing a method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is room 302 and you will correct it, ask the price, and then choose how to send it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。料金と受け取り条件を確認してからお決めください。追跡番号の控えは、ご家族にも共有すると状況を確認しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Decide after checking the price and receipt conditions. Sharing the tracking number receipt with your family will also make the status easier to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所を直しました。受付後に控えを写真で送り、届くまでは自分でも控えを保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先訂正を終え受付後の控え写真を家族へ送り配達まで保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have corrected the address. After acceptance I will send my family a photo of the receipt and keep it myself until delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have corrected the address and will send a receipt photo to your family after acceptance and keep it until delivery. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、訂正した宛先と送り方を最終確認します。ご家族にお知らせいただく際は、番号をお間違えなく。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-36206-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us make a final check of the corrected address and shipping method. Please give your family the correct number when notifying them. Thank you.
